name: CHAIN SNARE
text: When an enemy would Fall Back from a Hand of the Archon operative that has no other enemy in its control range, roll 2D6 (one die if the enemy has more Wounds than that operative): on any 4+ the Fall Back is cancelled with no AP spent and Chain Snare is used up for the turning point. A miss costs nothing and it stays ready.

name: WICKED BLADES
text: Every array of blades of your Hand of the Archon operatives has Atk 4.

name: TOXIN COATING
text: Up to twice per turning point, when a Hand of the Archon operative fights or retaliates and its melee weapon is chosen, that weapon has Lethal 5+ until the sequence ends. It costs no CP.

name: REFINED POISON
text: Up to twice per turning point, when a Hand of the Archon operative performs Shoot and picks a shardcarbine, splinter cannon, splinter pistol, splinter rifle or stinger pistol, that weapon's Normal Dmg is 1 higher until the action ends. It costs no CP.
